title: French Potato, Bacon and Cheese Bake
summary: A rich, comforting potato bake with smoky bacon, onions and a golden cheese topping. It’s hearty, savoury and ideal for a cosy dinner.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Grease a medium baking dish with a little butter.
Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil, add the sliced potatoes and simmer for 8 minutes until just starting to soften. Drain well.

Meanwhile, cook the bacon in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes until lightly browned. Add the onion and cook for another 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and thyme for 1 minute.
Layer half the potatoes in the baking dish, then spread over half the bacon and onion mixture. Season lightly. Repeat with the remaining potatoes and bacon mixture.
Mix the double cream and milk with the black pepper. Pour evenly over the potatoes, then scatter over the cheddar and parmesan.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until the top is golden brown and the potatoes are tender when pierced with a knife. Rest for 10 minutes before serving.
